source.work: Reconstructing the Clebsch code and its golden orientation from its deep-hole syndrome locus, and its computational companion Computational strengthenings of Clebsch syndrome rigidity
source.relation: Four programs of that companion were copied into this paper and adapted here. Each adapted file records the SHA-256 digest of the exact antecedent it was copied from, so the derivation is checkable against any published revision of the companion without naming a repository layout.

boundary: The scripts are exact trusted executions. The old syndrome and clique replays remain independent cross-checks, while the theorem-facing weight-eight and weight-ten claims use the structural theta and moment certificates. Lean checks the generated rank data against the semantic incidence relation and proves incidence-map rank 42 and code dimension 36. The structural Lean packets and remaining human transports are recorded in claim_map.json and the tracked axiom audit.
